decisions.decision: The Board did not endorse approval of the 909 Massachusetts Avenue Special Permit & Site Plan Review because a super-majority was not available for the special permit vote.
decisions.quote: approval was not endorsed as a super -majority was not available for the special permit vote.

decisions.decision: Board members to review the Housing Production Plan draft and email comments to A. Burney or provide them at the October 14th meeting, where it will be a short discussion item.
decisions.quote: board to review draft , see if strategies are pertinent, and email any comments to a. burney or provide at october 14th meeting.

decisions.decision: S. Lawton's target is to submit the HPP draft to DHCD by end-October; when submitted, the draft goes to the Board of Selectmen at the same time.
decisions.quote: s. lawton would like to submit draft to dhcd by end -october.

decisions.decision: The Working Map will be revised, and A. Burney and C. Fleck will work on defining Use Provisions; the Board is to review the revised draft.
decisions.quote: working map will be revised. a. burney and c. fleck will work on defining use provisions. board to review revised draft.

decisions.decision: A public forum on the village district will be held once the Board has narrowed its desired district boundary (suggested by A. Burney).
decisions.quote: a. burney suggested a public forum be held once the board has narrowed in on the ir desired district boundary.

decisions.decision: M. Allison, an abutter to the solar site, will contact the Ethics Commission for a judgment.
decisions.quote: m. allison is an abutter to the site and will contact the ethics commission for a judgment.
